title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Saturday, 26 September 2026
description: Today: Google confirms its Project Suncatcher orbital AI chip test will launch October 1; Brisbane and Fremantle deliver a grand final thriller at the MCG; the Dolphins' finals run ends as the Roosters reach their first grand final in seven years; and the Gold Coast enjoys a packed weekend of markets, movies under the stars, and live music. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
